userFacts.text: Memoleaf turns a voice memo into tidy meeting notes.
It transcribes 9 languages on the laptop, with no upload.
Notes export to Markdown and PDF.

beats.voice: Your meeting ended. The notes didn't.
beats.visual: A laptop lid closing on a messy notepad; the second line lands as it shuts
beats.motion: Slow push from frame 1; second line rises word by word

beats.visual: A long audio file on a timeline, the playhead not moving
beats.motion: The waveform scrolls past, the playhead stays at zero

beats.voice: Drop in the memo. Get the notes.
beats.visual: The product's own window: a memo file dropped in, headings and action items appear
beats.motion: File lands, progress line, notes build top to bottom

beats.visual: Language chips switch while the same note re-renders; an offline badge stays lit
beats.motion: Chips step across, the note crossfades text in place

beats.visual: The finished note exported side by side as Markdown and PDF
beats.motion: Two documents slide apart from one

beats.visual: The command alone on the brand colour, a cursor blinking after it

holds.why: End card: the command must be readable and copyable
